# Local icons

`lucide.min.js` is a tree-shaken, locally bundled subset of Lucide **0.468.0**, compiled with esbuild from the package's official ESM icon data and `replaceElement` implementation. `window.lucide.createIcons()` replaces elements with `data-lucide` attributes using only the studio's icons. No CDN or network request is used at runtime.

Included icons: arrow-left, arrow-right, check-circle-2 (circle-check alias), clapperboard, download, film, folder-open, layout-grid, mic, monitor-play, play, plus, save, shield-check, sliders-horizontal, sparkles, speech, upload-cloud (cloud-upload alias), wand-sparkles.

The original ISC license is retained in `LUCIDE-LICENSE`.
